# E-WIN Platform: Elite Workforce Impact Nigeria Project

The E-WIN Platform is the digital headquarters for the Elite Workforce Impact Nigeria (E-WIN) Project, founded by Omale Danjuma Ogale. The mission is to architect the future of the African workforce through AI-driven empowerment, digital upskilling, and the Impact Ambassador Model (I-AM).

## Primary Entities & Topics
- Organization: Elite Workforce Impact Nigeria Project (E-WIN)
- Founder & CEO: Omale Danjuma Ogale
- Core Initiative: Impact Ambassador Model (I-AM)
- Focus Areas: AI Consultancy, Youth Empowerment, Digital Transformation, Strategic Leadership.
